name: graph_edges_count_surplus
description: A graph payload whose '## edges [N]' section declares fewer edges than are present must be rejected. SPEC Section 13 is top-level ('Declared counts are normative at every nesting level; when a section header declares [N], exactly N data items MUST follow; decoders MUST reject count mismatches') and the graph edges section declares [N] (Section 6).
